text:
anya: planning to flip the feature flag `request_routing_safe_v2` for prod tomorrow 08:00 UTC. low-risk canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with 30m hold and smoke checks at each step.

mike: ok from infra side. who is driving the rollout? i can trigger canary and watch infra metrics.

anya: mike can you kick it? i'll own smoke checks and rollback readiness. kevin, can you be on standby for quick patch if routing mismatch shows up? @kevin

kevin: yep i'll be around 08:00-09:30 UTC. what are the exact smoke checks?

anya: basic list: 1) 95th p95 latency for text-gen under 300ms on canary, 2) error rate <=0.2% for routing errors, 3) no increase in KV cache miss rate >5%. i'll post quick dashboards links once i have them.

mike: deploy-bot will run the rollout. sequence:

```
# rollout steps (internal configctl)
configctl set-flag request_routing_safe_v2 on --scope=canary --pct=5 --actor=mike
sleep 1800  # 30m hold
configctl set-flag request_routing_safe_v2 on --scope=canary --pct=25 --actor=mike
sleep 1800
configctl set-flag request_routing_safe_v2 on --scope=prod --pct=100 --actor=mike
```

mike: i'll annotate each step with timestamp and reason in the rollout ticket.

sara: ops-oncall, can you watch infra alerts and be ready to flip the global kill-switch if needed? the kill-switch is `flagmaster kill request_routing_safe_v2`.

ops-oncall: noted. i'll be monitoring and will flip if >0.5% sustained errors or any backend 5xx spike.

kevin: if we see routing mismatches i can revert the routing table quickly. fallback plan: toggle flag back to previous variant (safe-routing-v1) and restart 2 router pods in each az.

anya: agreed. rollback commands (for quick copy):

```
# rollback to v1 immediately
configctl set-flag request_routing_safe_v2 off --scope=prod --actor=anya
kubectl rollout restart deployment/router -n inference -l tier=frontend
```

mike: i'll run the 5% canary at 08:00 UTC. i'll ping this thread and post deploy-bot messages. anyone object to the timing?

kevin: nope, good to go.

sara: fine by me.

anya: thanks — i'll prepare the dashboards and smoke checklist in the ticket. will post the links here before 07:45 UTC. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [08:00:00 UTC] rollout started: request_routing_safe_v2 -> 5% canary (actor: mike)

mike: canary step up complete, monitoring 30m now. initial metrics look clean (no regressions).

anya: seeing stable latency and error rates. proceeding with 25% at 08:35.

deploy-bot: [08:35:20 UTC] rollout update: request_routing_safe_v2 -> 25% (actor: mike)

ops-oncall: no alerts so far. continuing to watch.

anya: holding on 25% for 30m — so far so good. if we stay green i'll approve 100% at 09:05.

mike: approved, moving to 100% now.

deploy-bot: [09:06:10 UTC] rollout complete: request_routing_safe_v2 -> 100% (actor: mike)

anya: post-rollout checklist: run a few replay tests, confirm cache metrics, close ticket if all good. thanks everyone.

kevin: replay tests look fine. closing monitoring window at 10:00 UTC.

sara: nice. logging the change for audits.

anya: closing thread — no issues observed.
